title: An Integral-Based Framework for Preconditioning $f(A)b$
summary: The computation of the action of a matrix function on a vector, $f(A)b$, is a major computational bottleneck for large, sparse matrices, particularly when unfavorable spectral distributions cause standard Krylov subspace methods to stagnate. In this work, we propose a unified framework for preconditioning $f(A)b$ based on the Cauchy integral representation of the matrix function. By exploiting shift-invariance properties, we decouple the preconditioner evaluation from the Krylov subspace generation. We develop this framework in two distinct directions.
